identificationModule.briefTitle: Dapagliflozin Efficacy and Action in PCOS
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Dapagliflozin in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: a Multicentre, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy and safety of dapagliflozin on improving insulin resistance and hyperandrogenemia in obesity women with polycystic ovary syndrome.

armGroups.label: Dapagliflozin
armGroups.description: Dapagliflozin (Participants will receive dapagliflozin 10mg po qd).

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Placebo (Participants will receive placebo po qd)

interventions.name: Dapagliflozin
interventions.description: Participants will receive dapagliflozin 10mg po qd. Additionally, participants will receive lifestyle modification and nutrition education.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Participants will receive placebo po qd. Additionally, participants will receive lifestyle modification and nutrition education.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Improvement in insulin resistance over 12 weeks
primaryOutcomes.description: Change in insulin resistance assessed by insulin sensitivity index(HOMA-IR)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Improvement in serum androgen level over 12 weeks
primaryOutcomes.description: Change in androgen level assessed by free testosterone index(FAI)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in AUC (area under a curve) of glucose and insulin during the oral glucose tolerant test (OGTT)
Change in serum sex hormone binding globulin(SHBG)
Net change in total testosterone (TT) level
Net change in luteinzing hormone(LH) level

secondaryOutcomes.description: Liver fat will be assessed by liver fibroscan.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in ovulation rate assessed by serum progesterone

locations.facility: Nanfang Hospital of Southern Medical University

ancestors.term: Female Urogenital Diseases and Pregnancy Complications
